description: Instantiate a project from an active template's current snapshot; writes audit.

assignee_replacements.description: source user ID to target user ID; null removes the assignee

config_inputs.description: values for prompt config fields declared by the current snapshot; values are never returned

description.description: optional description override for the new project

expected_snapshot_hash.description: current snapshot hash returned by project_template_list

project_name.description: human-readable name for the new project

project_slug.description: unique slug for the new project

secret_inputs.description: secret values required by the current snapshot; values are never returned

snapshot_id.description: current snapshot UUID returned by project_template_list

start_date.description: project start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

workspace.description: workspace slug or UUID; required for every template call

name: project_template_instantiate
